title: Mojito Metallique
seo_title: DearBody Mojito Metallique Perfume | Soft, Creamy & Fruity Fragrance
seo_description: Discover DearBody Mojito Metallique, a London-formulated fragrance with soft creamy sweetness and a light fruity glow. A smooth, inviting scent for effortless everyday style.

metafields.custom.scent_description:
Meet Mojito Metallique — a fragrance made for the moments when you want to smell effortlessly put together without trying too hard.

Its soft, creamy sweetness creates a smooth and comforting first impression, while a light fruity glow gives the scent an uplifting edge. The result feels easy, approachable and full of personality.

Mojito Metallique is the kind of fragrance you can reach for when you want your scent to feel inviting rather than overpowering—something that moves naturally with your everyday style.

Whether you're heading out for coffee, meeting friends or simply want to add a little more personality to an ordinary day, this is a scent designed to become part of the moment.

Begin your DearBody scent journey with something soft, bright and easy to love.
metafields.custom.bullet_1:
SOFT, CREAMY CHARACTER
A smooth fragrance profile with an easy, comforting sweetness.
metafields.custom.bullet_2:
LIGHT FRUITY GLOW
A touch of fruitiness keeps the scent lively and bright without losing its softness.
metafields.custom.bullet_3:
EASY TO WEAR
An approachable fragrance personality designed to slip naturally into everyday moments.
metafields.custom.bullet_4:
EXPRESSIVE WITHOUT FEELING HEAVY
A balanced scent direction for anyone drawn to sweetness with a lighter feel.
metafields.custom.bullet_5:
PART OF THE DEARBODY SCENT JOURNEY
A London-formulated fragrance thoughtfully curated for the DearBody Philippines collection.
